blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The first lady, Louise “Liza” Araneta-Marcos, and Education Secretary Sonny Angara, together with the Philippine Reclamation Authority (PRA), launched a nationwide school-based hydroponics project at Las Piñas National High School and Parañaque National High School. According to a DepEd statement on Thursday, the project, part of the Agri Tayo, Lab for All program, introduces modern, space-efficient, and climate-resilient farming technologies to public schools. The first lady and Angara inspected the newly installed greenhouse units at Las Piñas National High School and interacted with students.
